Map comorbidity output flags to distinct conditions

Source: R/comorbidity-conditions.R
nis_comorbidity_condition_map.Rd

Inspect the condition IDs used by nis_comorbidity() when count_distinct = TRUE. A flag that represents multiple conditions has one row per component. Severity variants share an ID. For example, both diabetes flags map to diabetes, and refined Elixhauser's solid tumor and metastatic cancer flags map to solid_cancer. Leukemia and lymphoma retain separate IDs. Charlson's malignancy and metastatic solid tumor flags both map to malignancy, because its malignancy flag also covers leukemia and lymphoma.

Usage

nis_comorbidity_condition_map(
  method = "elixhauser_ahrq_icd10",
  prefix = "cmrb_"
)

Arguments

method

Comorbidity definition. The default "elixhauser_ahrq_icd10" uses the medicalcoder ICD-10-CM union. "elixhauser_ahrq2022" through "elixhauser_ahrq2027" select a specific release. Use "charlson_quan2005" for Quan coding with original Charlson weights, "charlson_quan2011" for the same coding with Quan 2011 weights, and "charlson_deyo1992" for Deyo ICD-9-CM coding with original weights. "elixhauser_quan2005" uses Quan ICD-9-CM or ICD-10 coding and legacy AHRQ weights. "elixhauser_ahrq_web" and "elixhauser_elixhauser1998" replicate medicalcoder's legacy ICD-9 code-based algorithms. All methods except "elixhauser_ahrq2027" require the medicalcoder package.

prefix

Prefix for the added columns. Choose a prefix that does not collide with an existing name.

Value

A data frame with character columns output (the prefixed logical column name) and condition (the unprefixed ID to count or exclude). The map omits summary counts, indices, and the any flag.

Details

The map describes the emitted flags, including medicalcoder combination and compatibility flags. For example, hfhtn_cxrenlfl_sev maps to heart failure (hf), hypertension, and renal_failure. The count takes the union of the conditions represented by true flags. It applies no further hierarchy or present-on-admission adjudication.

References

AHRQ HCUP. Elixhauser Comorbidity Software Refined for ICD-10-CM.

Dewitt PE. medicalcoder, version 0.10.0. The combination flag names and decomposition follow the package's refined Elixhauser mappings.

Quan H et al. Coding algorithms for defining comorbidities in ICD-9-CM and ICD-10 administrative data. Med Care. 2005;43(11):1130–1139.

See also

Other comorbidity: nis_comorbidity()

Examples

nis_comorbidity_condition_map("elixhauser_ahrq2027", prefix = "risk_")

#> 1          risk_aids          aids
#> 2       risk_alcohol       alcohol
#> 3       risk_anemdef       anemdef
